whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Red Velvet Bakery,

I noticed your bakery has stellar 4.8★ reviews across 94 happy customers in Gardanibagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and custom cake inquiry page.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, birthday/anniversary menu, aur location guide integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/redvelvet

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Red Velvet Bakery, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Red Velvet Bakery) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and mobile-first menu browsing for customers in Gardanibagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact bakery items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
